results.content:
In that same vein, frustration with Trump’s policies is now showing up among his past supporters. According to Pew Research, Trump’s approval among his 2024 voters has fallen from 95% in February 2025 to 67% now.

Within the larger GOP voter base, whereas 91% of Republicans approved of Trump’s handling of the economy in 2018, that has fallen to 69% according to Economist/YouGov trackers.

Midterms are often decided by turnout, so a demoralized base could be fatal to Republican candidates.
